main_body: Tree-stump chopping block with a small axe blade on top; the body is a round log with an elliptical lighter top and a darker barrel-like front face
top_band: Orange #b77246 ellipse, rows 4-7 at x=8 (L~125), above a darker brown front (L~101)
evidence: At x=8 the column reads axe blade rows 1-3, a lighter orange top rows 4-7 with rounded corners, then a darker front rows 8-14 (7 rows). The top is a real 4-row ellipse-like surface, not a rim, and the front face sits clearly below it. The step is soft (about 23 L) and there is no distinct front-edge line, but the dark shaded right side at x=11 (L 68, rows 8-13) and the dark row 9/11 grain marks give the front its own shading. Marginal but it reads as 3/4.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 10 distinct colours against 40 and 38 in the references, and a median of 10 colours per tile against 17 and 20. The wood ramp has about 4 steps (#b77246, #9a5435, #6d3b15, #411e05), and the dark edge pixels are 53% neutral, so the outline is partly near-black. Grain is limited to a few dark marks and the blade is only 2-3 tones. It reads thinner and more sticker-like than the stall and well beside it, although there are no big flat fills.
